items.summary: CTO review: conditionally approve queue admission for the single bounded SEO change on stinkyleftfoot.com. The work is technically feasible, isolated to one existing page, low effort, reversible by commit rollback, and measurable using existing GSC and GA4 evidence without adding telemetry. Engineer may implement only the stated metadata, heading/intro, and internal-link scope. Do not deploy or claim lift until build, indexability, canonical, robots, sitemap, link, disclosure, and diff-scope checks pass. Treat the 1.2% CTR target as an experimental threshold only; revenue, ROI, margin, cost-to-learn, forecast, and causal-lift claims remain unsupported. If validation fails or the page becomes non-indexable, revert the isolated commit and return evidence.
